notes.title: Dr. Atominus 2.5.0
notes.content: [p]In this update there are lots of quality of life improvements, harder difficulty mode, native Linux support and more. The game page has a new trailer that tells about this update, so check it out. [/p][p][/p][h2]Quality of life improvements[/h2][p][/p][h3]Improved knockback[/h3][p]Knockback was improved. There is a new sprite for the atom and the knockback is a bit more realistic and feels nicer.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37633421/77966bcb754213b8b2055714c553e02d8b4f3762.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][h3]Improved third boss battle[/h3][p]Third boss battle was improved by making the boss faster in the second phase. The performance of this battle was also improved a lot.[/p][p][/p][h3]Remastered sound[/h3][p]Music is now stereo instead of mono. Also more sound effects were added to some cutscenes and other parts. The volume of different sound effects was balanced.[/p][p]Also, sound volume can now be changed in the game. Music and sound effect volumes can be changed separately.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37633421/2da568d04d08479e6c163a72e1f549eca4312172.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][h3]Bug fixes and other things[/h3][list][*][p]Added language select when starting the game for the first time[/p][/*][*][p]Added better instruction in true ending[/p][/*][*][p]Added version number to main menu[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]Centered text in intro cutscene & epilogue intro cutscene[/p][/*][*][p]Some performance improvements[/p][/*][*][p]Loading language and settings is now quicker when starting the game[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed pressing esc/start in main menu displaying pause menu – now it works as a "back" button[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed atom walking in place in a cutscene[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed going to pause menu when pressing back from map, even when map was accessed directly[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h2]Hard difficulty mode[/h2][p]Many people felt like the game was too easy. So now there is a hard difficulty mode that can be enabled from the settings.[/p][p]However, note that since the normal game mode is very easy, the hard mode is not super hard, it's maybe more like normal mode in some other games.[/p][p]The hard mode will affect only boss battles, by making the bosses have more hp. From my experience, this improves especially the battle against Dr. Atominus.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37633421/f61c72d5a999c1dba94692e95b47d04f295b0b75.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][h2]Native Linux support on Steam[/h2][p]Steam version of the game has now native Linux support. Itch.io version already had this, but due to bugs in the game engine, it was difficult to add to Steam. However, now it is finally here.[/p][p]The game worked perfectly with proton, but the native Linux version has some advantages, like faster startup and the game files are easier to browse.[/p][p][/p][h2]Saving system change and backwards compatibility[/h2][p]Like mentioned in a previous post, the saving system was changed for the Playstation version, and the change has been added to the PC version too. Because of this, the new version is not compatible with old save files.[/p][p]Sorry if this causes any trouble, but the game is short, so it might be a good chance to replay it. :)[/p][p][/p][h2]Biggest sale yet[/h2][p]With this update, there is a -55% sale discount.[/p][p][/p][p]That is all. If you have any feedback, let me know in the comments or in the Steam forum.[/p]

notes.title: About an upcoming update
notes.content: [p]I have been working on a 5-year anniversary update for Dr. Atominus. It's coming a bit late, but here is a sneak peak to the update and also some other important info.[/p][p][/p][h2]A lot of polishing and quality of life updates[/h2][p]The update will include many small improvements to the game, like improved knockback, hard difficulty and remastered sound. There are also performance improvements and bug fixes.[/p][p]Along with the update, native Linux support will be coming to Steam. It already works well with proton, but native support has some advantages, like faster startup and easier to navigate game files.[/p][p][/p][h2]Saving system change and backwards compatibility[/h2][p]Recently Dr. Atominus became available for Playstation 4. A new efficient save system was added for this and it will be on the PC version too. Because of this, old save files will not be compatible with the updated game. That is why I'm telling about the update in advance, so in case you are just playing through the game, you might want to disable updates temporarily. The update will probably be coming either next week or the week after that.[/p][p][/p][p]I will tell more details about the update when it comes.[/p][p][/p][p]Edit: The update will be coming August 11.[/p]

Dr. Atominus was just updated! In this update, some graphics were improved and there were also some other small improvements.

notes.title: Dr. Atominus available now
notes.content:
Hello everyone!

[b]Dr. Atominus has been published![/b] Get it now on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/1294750/Dr_Atominus/

[previewyoutube=_cB6nX6ERMo;full][/previewyoutube]

Dr. Atominus is a short platformer with metroidvania elements and a cool sci-fi story.

Story
Dr. Atominus finally succeeds to magnify an atom. But the atom is alive and it escapes! Play as the atom who wants to escape from the experiments of Dr. Atominus and find out why the scientist needs you so badly.

Explore the 4th dimension, get unique abilities, and eventually, make the right choices.

[b]Features:[/b]
[list]
[*]     4 areas to explore
[*]     5 bosses
[*]     3 different endings
[*]     Interesting sci-fi story
[*]     Good chiptune music
[/list]


[b]Upcoming updates[/b]

notes.title: Launch date and other news

Hello everyone!

In this update I'll tell you the launch date of Dr. Atominus. Also I'll talk about some recent improvements in the game. Also there is a new trailer.

[h2]LAUNCH DATE IS SET[/h2]
[h3]Dr. Atominus will launch 22.7.2020![/h3] Only three weeks from now!


[h2]NEW TRAILER[/h2]
The game has changed a lot and a new trailer was needed. The existing trailer focused on the story, but this one focuses more on the gameplay. Here it is:
[previewyoutube=km-87JSpdOk;full][/previewyoutube]

[b]Map[/b]
A map was added to the game. It doesn't show your location, but it's very helpful to find new places.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37633421/f64721af2d372f6fb2ab52658e748c478a7e68ea.gif[/img]

[b]UI[/b]
The User Interface has been improved. Blue coins were removed, because they didn't have any use. Also, now coins are health. The Atom uses energy from them to keep alive. Also, I made the pause menu a little better looking.


[b]Bug fixes[/b]
I have also fixed dozens of bugs in the past weeks. Some of them were really weird.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37633421/8588bcd735e437678b158f06ba5f1299dfc32a9b.gif[/img]
